name: cdm/observable/asset/BasketConstituent
description: Identifies the constituents of the basket

Asset.description: The object to be observed is an Asset, ie something that can be owned and transferred in the financial markets.

Basket.description: The object to be observed is a Basket, ie a collection of Observables with an identifier and optional weightings.

finalValuationPrice.description: Specifies a final price schedule to be associated to an individual underlier that is a basket constituent. The multiple cardinality is aligned to the one of the PriceQuantity->price that this price is referencing.

Index.description: The object to be observed is an Index, ie an observable computed on the prices, rates or valuations of a number of assets.

initialValuationPrice.description: Specifies an initial price schedule to be associated to an individual underlier that is a basket constituent. The multiple cardinality is aligned to the one of the PriceQuantity->price that this price is referencing.

interimValuationPrice.description: Specifies an interim price schedule to be associated to an individual underlier that is a basket constituent. The multiple cardinality is aligned to the one of the PriceQuantity->price that this price is referencing.

quantity.description: Specifies a quantity schedule to be associated to an individual underlier that is a basket constituent. The multiple cardinality is aligned to the one of the PriceQuantity->quantity that this quantity is referencing.
